data.body:
[P2] Establish regression evidence for the original failure

Rule 5, “A bug fix starts with a failing test,” remains unmet. The description acknowledges that implementation and tests share one commit and supplies no before-fix regression-test result. This test calls `runner_command`, which does not exist on the base revision, so its baseline failure demonstrates a missing helper rather than reproducing the hard-coded Jest invocation. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and agree on regression evidence that demonstrates the original failure before the fix.
